_note: Bottle Shot finale, played inside the gang's stash. The district picks the weapon and the stash set; the level's place inside its district (0 = first, 9 = boss) picks the difficulty row. Bottles stand on a plane `distance` metres in front of the hero (x sideways, y height above the stand's floor). Shots = target bottles (normal + gold) + spare. Coins = (clear_bonus + troops x per_troop) x (1 + sum over hits of bonus_per_bottle x combo) x (gold_mult if the gold bottle broke) x station bonus. combo = 1 + combo_step x (hits in a row - 1), capped at combo_max; a miss or a decoy resets it.

difficulty._note: One entry per level inside a district. count = normal bottles (one gold bottle is added), decoys = clay jugs that reset the combo, spare = shots beyond one per target, size = bottle and hit-zone scale, dist = x the weapon's distance, amp/speed = motion (metres, rad/s), wind = metres/s^2 of sideways push at most (bow only).

knife._note: Drag to aim, release to throw. Straight line plus a small visual arc; slow-motion chase camera.

pistol._note: First person, iron sights. mag rounds per magazine; reload_s = reload animation; kick_deg = muzzle rise per shot, recovered over recover_s. speed = bullet speed along the range (m/s); slow = time scale while a bullet is out.

bow._note: First person. Hold to draw (draw_s to full), drag to aim, release to loose. The pin sight is set for a full draw with no wind at the base distance; past steady_s the arm starts to shake. Wind pushes sideways (difficulty.wind x wind).

stars._note: Swipe: direction aims, swipe speed sets the throw speed (slow = drops). Steel plates beside the rows bounce a star along the row for ricochet_len metres.

sniper._note: Rooftop to rooftop. Touch to raise the scope, drag to aim, release to fire. Sway (breathing) + tremor; for steady_s after scoping in the sway drops to steady_k, then grows to worse_k. Zeroed at `zero` metres. cycle_s = bolt action. bullet_cam = time scale of the slow-motion bullet camera on a hit.
